name: A73

Platform.Operating system: Initial: Android 10 with ColorOS 7.2, Current: Android 11 with ColorOS 11
Platform.CPU: Qualcomm Snapdragon 662 (11 nm), Octa-core (4×2.3 GHz Kryo 260 Gold & 4×1.8 GHz Kryo 260 Silver)
